dashboard.subtitle: Malawi's all-in-one digital services platform — one login, every service.
dashboard.blurbRich: From fair rentals on <0>265Nyumba</0> to errands on <1>SendUs</1>, everything lives behind this single hub.
dashboard.modulesIntro: Choose a service to open its workspace. Locked tiles are on the roadmap for partners and early users.

nyumba.name: 265Nyumba
nyumba.description: Landlords list homes; tenants search by city, price, and rooms—then contact owners directly. Built to cut the “half rent to agents” problem in Malawi.

sendus.name: SendUs
sendus.description: Request groceries, parcel pickup, bill payments, queue standing, or document runs. Runners accept jobs like a lightweight “Uber for errands”.

courier.name: 265Courier
courier.description: Book Blantyre ↔ Lilongwe (and beyond) deliveries with tracking and clear pricing for senders and drivers.

market.name: 265Market
market.description: Electronics, furniture, phones, and cars—peer-to-peer listings with chat and safer handoffs than random Facebook threads.

services.name: 265Services
services.description: Plumbers, electricians, cleaners, movers—post a job, compare offers, and hire verified service providers near you.

jobs.name: 265Jobs
jobs.description: Event help, cleaning shifts, security, temp labour—quick jobs for students and casual workers.

property-mgmt.name: 265Property Management
property-mgmt.description: Rent rolls, tenant records, reminders, maintenance tickets, and simple reports—after Nyumba scales, this owns the landlord back-office.

payments.name: 265Payments
payments.description: Mobile money and bank rails across modules: escrow for SendUs, listing fees for Nyumba, and payouts to runners or couriers.

ride.name: 265Ride
ride.description: Motorbike or car rides and pooled routes in Blantyre / Lilongwe—natural upsell once trust and payments exist on the platform.

launchpad.name: Module launchpad
launchpad.description: Placeholder for future verticals (e.g. agritech leads, student housing, or B2B logistics). Swap in real modules as you ship.
